summary: This standards-track RFC defines how to carry HEVC video, also known as H.265, in RTP packets. It allows one or more units of the encoded video to be packetized for transmission.

eli5.summary: A video is chopped into little packets, and this explains how to pack and label H.265 video so it can be sent over a network and rebuilt.

questions: how to stream h.265 over rtp
